title: From GPT-3 to GPT-5: Mapping their capabilities, scope, limitations, and consequences

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and document analysis of official system cards, technical reports, and secondary studies to track reported disparities, representational harms, and unequal distributions of capability across different demographic groups.

Qualitative review of existing literature and model documentation to assess how models systematically replicate socially objectionable patterns, stereotypes, exclusions, and culturally specific defaults.
Review of technical documentation and peer-reviewed research identifying uneven model performance and quality variability across different languages and user accents.
